title: Blue Skies | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked away in the serene Lake District of Watercolor, this charming coastal cottage epitomizes luxury and comfort. With its picturesque front porch complete with a swing bed, guests can soak in the verdant views while experiencing the peace of this exclusive neighborhood. Inside, the home unfolds with an airy ambiance accentuated by 12-foot ceilings and soft coastal tones. An open floor plan on the first floor merges the living room and kitchen into a harmonious living space, equipped with top-tier appliances like a Sub Zero refrigerator and a Wolf range. The inviting dining area, with seating for eight and additional bar stools at the center island, makes it an ideal setting for gathering and feasting. Upstairs, the refinement continues with three suite-style bedrooms, including a master suite that offers sanctuary-like comfort with its plush king-sized bed and private bath. The home’s thoughtful layout includes a variety of sleeping arrangements to accommodate up to 14 guests without sacrificing privacy or comfort. Outside, the allure of this vacation home is magnified by its private plunge pool and covered outdoor fireplace, providing a perfect blend of relaxation and entertainment options year-round. Whether cooling off in the pool after a sunny day at the beach or cozying up by the fire on a brisk evening, this Watercolor home ensures every moment of your stay is steeped in comfort and style.
